implementation_notes: This manifest is consumed fail-closed by the inventory generator, PyInstaller specification, and software-package staging validation.

All license assets under source/fixed_app/licenses/qt-5.15.2 are byte-preserving copies of the pinned upstream source member, except the Chromium LICENSE fetched from the exact recorded Chromium commit.

The full existing Qt 5.15.2 corresponding-source archive covers qtbase and qtimageformats source code. The separately preserved Chromium LICENSE supplies a notice referenced by ANGLE but absent from the Qt source archive.
